name: Operator feedback (fictional data only)
about: Explain a front-desk workflow using only made-up reservations and hotel data
---

## What were you trying to do? / Hangi işi denedin?
Describe the workflow, not a real guest or property record.

## Fictional reproduction / Kurgusal tekrarlama
Example: two synthetic reservations both request room category `standard`.

## Expected vs observed / Beklenen ve görülen
What should have happened? What did you see?

## Environment / Ortam
Browser or Python version; public demo or offline viewer; displayed language.

## Improvement suggestion / Öneri
What would make the result clearer, safer or easier?

## Privacy confirmation / Gizlilik onayı
- [ ] All reservations, rooms, names and dates above are invented.
- [ ] No real guest data, employee identities, passport/ID numbers, hotel URLs, access tokens or private screenshots are included.
- [ ] No vendor-proprietary training material or non-public integration details are attached.

For guided steps see [the TR/EN feedback guide](../../docs/OPERATOR_FEEDBACK_TR_EN.md). This is not a request for production deployment.
